req.title: Update task
req.statement: The system shall update mutable fields of the task and return the updated object when PUT /tasks/{task_id} is called with a valid body.

doc.reasoning: The PUT /tasks/{task_id} endpoint must: (1) return HTTP 200 with the updated task on valid input, (2) return HTTP 404 when the task does not exist, (3) support partial updates (only provided fields change), (4) enforce field constraints (title min_length=1, max_length=100, description max_length=500). Tests cover EP (normal update), NEG (missing task, invalid body), BVA (title at length boundaries 1 and 100 chars, description at 500 chars), STC (completed flag toggled false->true->false), and DT (partial vs full update). Each test creates its own task via POST to remain self-contained and idempotent against an empty database.

tests.name: test_update_task_all_fields_returns_200_with_updated_data
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/
actions: POST /tasks/ with title='Original', description='Orig desc', completed=false
PUT /tasks/{task_id} with title='Updated', description='New desc', completed=true
expected: Response body has id matching created task
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import sqlalchemy, os
from app.database import Base, engine

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_update_task_all_fields_returns_200_with_updated_data():
    r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Original', 'description': 'Orig desc', 'completed': False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    task_id = r.json()['id']

    r2 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'title': 'Updated', 'description': 'New desc', 'completed': True})
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    body = r2.json()
    assert body['id'] == task_id
    assert body['title'] == 'Updated'
    assert body['description'] == 'New desc'
    assert body['completed'] == True

test_update_task_all_fields_returns_200_with_updated_data()
